item.title: Waggrakine Primary School students create special stall, The Sunny Cabin, to fundraise for FightMND
item.description: The enterprising and charitable spirit of three Waggrakine Primary School students has emerged in full force, thanks to a school project that has seen them raise funds for a worthy cause.

item.title: Women Inspiring Better Business celebrating Christmas and 10-year anniversary at Jingle & Mingle event
item.description: A local not-for-profit organisation is celebrating 10 years of bringing women together and empowering them through networking.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton part of CSIRO’s national rollout of African Boxthorn Biocontrol Program
item.description: The invasive African boxthorn weed is in the crosshairs of a new scheme which has seen the City of Greater Geraldton join forces with the CSIRO.

item.title: Geraldton water polo round 7: B52’s men’s and women’s A-grade sides score impressive wins
item.description: B52’s showed their depth with both their men’s and women’s A-grade sides scoring impressive wins, keeping them firmly in the conversation for end of season honours in Geraldton water polo.

item.title: Geraldton softball Rd 7: Suiside men’s division 1 keep tight grip on top spot while Martians women a standout
item.description: Tight finishes, big batting innings and a few heroic moments wrapped up round seven of the Geraldton softball season, as Suiside keep their grip on the men’s division one ladder with a 6-4 win over Rams.

item.title: Young Motors Women’s T20: Bushfire emergency sees match between Wanderers and CVN abandoned
item.description: A bushfire emergency saw a premature end to the Young Motors Women’s T20 match at GBSC Sports Park on Sunday, as Wanderers claimed victory over Chapman Valley-Northampton in unusual circumstances.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton puts stop on accepting surrendered animals at its facility until further notice
item.description: The City of Greater Geraldton will not be accepting surrendered animals at its animal management until further notice.

item.title: Geraldton surveys a near-miss catastrophe as devastated streets slowly reappear after bushfire contained
item.description: As the smoke finally lifts over Geraldton’s northern suburbs, the scale of destruction left behind by the fast moving weekend bushfire has become starkly visible.

item.title: Community rallies as seismic blasting approved off Dongara coast, sparking fears for marine & local fisheries
item.description: Community concern over plans for seismic blasting off the Dongara coast will take centre stage on Friday, with residents gathering for a Sundowner and Film Night hosted by Dongara Against Seismic Blasting.

item.title: Geraldton bushfire origin traced to Heal Cl in Spalding as one home lost and two more left unlivable
item.description: The extent of damage left behind by the Geraldton bushfire is becoming clear, with investigators confirming the blaze first ignited in Spalding on Friday before tearing through suburbs on Sunday and Monday.
